_note: Pluggable music engine (the one generation axis that used to be hardcoded Suno). provider = lyria | suno. Lyria 3 (Google, via the Gemini API) makes vocal songs AND instrumental score, with cleaner commercial licensing + SynthID watermarking; Suno is the fallback / vocal-song alternative. Beds under narration stay instrumental (the prompt says 'no vocals'); a future lyrics control unlocks full vocal songs.
_status: Lyria client is wired + verified-correct (the Gemini v1beta/interactions endpoint accepted the request + model id), but the current GEMINI_API_KEY project returned HTTP 429 'not enough quota' for the Lyria 3 PREVIEW models — enable billing / request Lyria quota on that Google Cloud project. Until then default stays 'suno'. TO ENABLE LYRIA once quota is live: set provider='lyria' here (fallback 'suno' kept as a safety net), or env MUSIC_PROVIDER=lyria.

lyria._note: Gemini API (GEMINI_API_KEY), POST v1beta/interactions. pro = full song up to ~3 min; clip = fast 30s draft. Vocals + timed lyrics via [Verse]/[Chorus] tags in the prompt; omit them for an instrumental bed. PREVIEW models — VERIFY the model ids on ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/music-generation before a big paid run.
